name: Pinme
headline: Pinme - Effortless Frontend Deployment Tool
short_description: Pinme allows developers to deploy their frontend applications effortlessly with a single command. It supports Claude Code Skills, making deployment simple and efficient for static sites and serverless hosting.
author: glitternetwork

sections.overview:
Pinme is a deployment tool designed for developers who want to ship frontend applications quickly without complex configuration. It streamlines the deployment process to a single command, making it ideal for static sites and serverless hosting environments. The tool integrates with Claude Code Skills, enabling AI-assisted development workflows. Pinme abstracts away infrastructure complexity, allowing developers to focus on building rather than managing deployment pipelines. It's particularly valuable for rapid prototyping, side projects, and teams seeking efficient deployment automation.
Deploy a static site with a single command to save time and reduce complexity.
Host a frontend application serverlessly, eliminating the need for server management.
Utilize Claude Code Skills to automate deployment processes seamlessly.
Simplify frontend deployment workflows, allowing for quick iterations and updates.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install glitternetwork/pinme`
`git clone https://github.com/glitternetwork/pinme`
sections.usage:
```
Deploy my frontend application using Pinme. The application is located at [REPOSITORY_URL] and uses [FRAMEWORK] as the framework. I want to deploy it to [DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT] with the following configuration: [CONFIGURATION_DETAILS].
```
Copy

```
Your application has been successfully deployed using Pinme. The deployment details are as follows:

- **Repository URL**: https://github.com/yourusername/your-repo
- **Framework**: React
- **Deployment Environment**: Production
- **Configuration Details**:
  - Environment variables set
  - Build optimized for production
  - SSL certificate enabled
- **Deployment Status**: Successful
- **Deployment URL**: https://your-app.pinme.io
- **Deployment Time**: 2 minutes 30 seconds

Your application is now live and accessible at the provided URL. If you have any further questions or need assistance, feel free to reach out.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
